evals.prompt: Improve validation accuracy to 92%. Budget: 20 iterations.
evals.expected_output: Creates/updates .opencode/decisions/goal_state.json with mode maximize and target 92, then loops (measure -> diagnose -> plan -> execute) until current >= target or the budget ends; reports SUCCESS with the before -> after delta.
expectations: State file .opencode/decisions/goal_state.json is created with mode "maximize" and target 92
A baseline is measured with the recorded measure_cmd before the first change
best_metric tracks max(best, current) each iteration
The loop stops once current_metric >= target and sets achieved=true (SUCCESS)
Progress is reported as current/best/target with a before -> after delta

evals.prompt: Cut the API p95 latency down to 120 ms. Budget: 15 iterations.
evals.expected_output: Runs a minimize loop: success when current <= target, best_metric = min(best, current), and SUCCESS reported only at or below the target.
expectations: mode is "minimize" and target is 120
Success is evaluated as current_metric <= target (not >=)
best_metric tracks min(best, current)
The verdict stays non-success until the metric is at or below the target

evals.prompt: Tune the cache size to exactly 1024 entries. No budget preference.
evals.expected_output: Runs an exact-value loop with a default 1% tolerance and best_metric = value closest to target; with no budget given it defaults to max_iterations 20.
expectations: mode is "exact" and target is 1024
Success uses a tolerance around the target (default 1% of target), not exact equality
best_metric is the value closest to target, not the max or the min
With no budget stated, budget.max_iterations defaults to 20

evals.prompt: You changed the optimizer and accuracy dropped from the best 0.87 to 0.81. Keep going.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes degradation (maximize: current < best_metric), reverts to the last checkpoint, logs the failed iteration, and tries a different approach instead of retrying the same one.
expectations: Recognizes degradation (0.81 < best_metric 0.87 in maximize mode)
Reverts to the last recorded checkpoint before trying again
Logs the failed iteration in history with its checkpoint reference
Does not repeat the same failed approach without changing a variable

evals.prompt: Keep tuning, but you have 5 iterations left and the last 3 improved nothing.
evals.expected_output: Stops instead of looping past the budget: sets budget.budget_exhausted=true (and switches paradigm after 3 consecutive flat iterations), logs a report, and returns BUDGET EXHAUSTED / CEILING REACHED.
expectations: Stops instead of looping past budget.max_iterations
Sets budget.budget_exhausted=true and returns BUDGET EXHAUSTED / CEILING REACHED
After 3 consecutive flat-or-failed iterations on the same approach, switches paradigm
Reports a progress summary instead of spending the remaining budget
